python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile
import shutil
import os
import re

src = '/home/user/Desktop/sample-recruitment-phone-script.odt'
backup = '/home/user/Desktop/sample-recruitment-phone-script.odt.bak'
tmp = '/tmp/sample-recruitment-phone-script.odt.new'

# Make a backup
shutil.copy2(src, backup)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'r') as zin:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = zin.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename in ('content.xml', 'styles.xml'):
                text = data.decode('utf-8')
                # Replace yellow highlight (any case) with transparent
                # Common values: #ffff00, #FFFF00
                before = text
                text = re.sub(r'fo:background-color="#[fF]{2}[fF]{2}00"', 'fo:background-color="transparent"', text)
                # Also catch any other non-transparent background-color in text styles, conservatively
                # (Only replace exact yellow to avoid touching unrelated colors)
                changes = before != text
                if changes:
                    print(f"Modified {item.filename}")
                data = text.encode('utf-8')
            # mimetype must be stored uncompressed and first - preserve compression mode
            if item.filename == 'mimetype':
                zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(item.filename)
                zi.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_STORED
                zout.writestr(zi, data)
            else:
                zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(tmp, src)
print("Done. Backup at", backup)
EOF
